entries.title: A website you sign in to in a task's browser on another computer stays signed in
entries.body: When a crewmate on another of your computers asks you to sign in to a website in its browser, your sign-in now stays on that computer for later tasks, as it already did on this one. The browser now names that computer as where your sign-in stays. Before, it ended when that browser stopped, so you had to sign in again each time.
entries.noPicture: This changes where an existing sign-in is kept, not how any view looks.
